notes: This finding contains a refutation. Two aggregators put the ceiling at EUR 50,000 and one regional network page said EUR 30,000, so published page was read and it says EUR 30,000; the aggregator figure is wrong or describes a different scheme, and the smaller number is recorded. The physical-person route is the only clause that admits somebody without a company, and it is conditioned on an incubator that has its own selection committee, which converts a formality into a discretionary review. (a) A foreign founder can apply through a French incubator partner: plausible, because the pre-creation route does not name a nationality and the eligibility criterion is French registration of the future company. (b) French residence is required: unverified, nothing read states it. (c) The grant can pay for cloud compute: plausible, since it funds 'depenses de R&D internes et externes', but no expense schedule was read. What would verify the terms: the Bpifrance notice de cahier des charges for the current year, which was not published on the page read.
